verdict.rationale: The firm's own IP practice page names a trade secrets team that helps clients set up information protection programs, which covers the confidentiality-program part of the story. That support rests on a single sentence, and nothing shows employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. Missing for 10: documented employee-mobility or non-compete dispute work, trade-secret litigation experience or matters, more detailed first-party description of the trade-secret practice, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: Our trade secrets team regularly helps clients establish information protection programs to safeguard sensitive business information.
